untourism.name: UN Tourism
untourism.note: Local noncommercial research; redistribution/derivative restrictions require review before sharing text.
untourism.robots_text:
#
# robots.txt — production (www.untourism.int)
#
# Hardened for security + SEO. Replaces the previous version which
# (a) blocked the /node/ system paths that Drupal actually serves with
#     index,follow and self-canonical -> Google reported 80k+
#     "Blocked by robots.txt"; (b) referenced /sp/sitemap.xml which 404s.
#
# Security principle: defence in depth. Even though Drupal/Apache already
# return 403 for admin & private files, we ALSO tell crawlers to stay out.
# These Disallow lines never expose anything -- they only ask compliant
# crawlers not to fetch URLs that we expect to be protected at the app level.
#
# NOTE: robots.txt is NOT an access-control mechanism. Sensitive endpoints
# MUST also be protected by Drupal permissions, HTTP auth, or WAF rules.
#

User-agent: *

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ALLOW -- so Google can render the page (CSS / JS / fonts / public images)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Allow: /core/*.css$
Allow: /core/*.css?
Allow: /core/*.js$
Allow: /core/*.js?
Allow: /core/themes/
Allow: /core/modules/*/js/
Allow: /core/modules/*/css/
Allow: /core/misc/
Allow: /core/assets/
Allow: /core/*.gif
Allow: /core/*.jpg
Allow: /core/*.jpeg
Allow: /core/*.png
Allow: /core/*.svg
Allow: /core/*.webp
Allow: /profiles/*.css$
Allow: /profiles/*.css?
Allow: /profiles/*.js$
Allow: /profiles/*.js?
Allow: /profiles/*.gif
Allow: /profiles/*.jpg
Allow: /profiles/*.jpeg
Allow: /profiles/*.png
Allow: /profiles/*.svg
# Public user-uploaded files. More-specific Disallows below override
# this for /sites/*/files/private/, /styles/*/private/, backup_migrate, tmp.
Allow: /sites/*/files/

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- Drupal internals
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disallow: /core/
Disallow: /profiles/
Disallow: /vendor/
Disallow: /modules/
Disallow: /themes/

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- system / installer / config files (never crawl, never index)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disallow: /README.txt
Disallow: /CHANGELOG.txt
Disallow: /INSTALL.txt
Disallow: /INSTALL.mysql.txt
Disallow: /INSTALL.pgsql.txt
Disallow: /INSTALL.sqlite.txt
Disallow: /LICENSE.txt
Disallow: /MAINTAINERS.txt
Disallow: /UPGRADE.txt
Disallow: /install.php
Disallow: /update.php
Disallow: /authorize.php
Disallow: /web.config
Disallow: /.env
Disallow: /.htaccess
Disallow: /.git
Disallow: /composer.json
Disallow: /composer.lock
Disallow: /package.json
Disallow: /sites/default/settings.php
Disallow: /sites/*/settings.php
Disallow: /sites/*/settings.local.php
Disallow: /sites/*/services.yml

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- Drupal admin surface
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /index.php/admin/
Disallow: /batch
Disallow: /devel/

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- auth & user management
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disallow: /user/register
Disallow: /user/password
Disallow: /user/login
Disallow: /user/logout
Disallow: /user/reset/
Disallow: /user/*/edit
Disallow: /user/*/cancel
Disallow: /user/*/security
Disallow: /user/*/sessions
Disallow: /index.php/user/register
Disallow: /index.php/user/password
Disallow: /index.php/user/login
Disallow: /index.php/user/logout

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- content management actions
#   IMPORTANT: we DO allow /node/X canonical pages so Google can follow
#   them, but we block edit/delete/revision actions explicitly.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disallow: /node/add
Disallow: /node/*/edit
Disallow: /node/*/delete
Disallow: /node/*/revisions
Disallow: /node/*/translations
Disallow: /node/*/devel
Disallow: /node/*/webform-results
Disallow: /index.php/node/add
Disallow: /media/*/edit
Disallow: /media/*/delete
Disallow: /media/*/revisions
Disallow: /taxonomy/term/*/edit
Disallow: /taxonomy/term/*/delete
Disallow: /comment/*/edit
Disallow: /comment/*/delete
Disallow: /comment/reply/
Disallow: /index.php/comment/reply/

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- filters, forms (low-value, infinite spaces)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# NOTE: /search is deliberately NOT disallowed here. unwto_core_page_attachments_alter()
# serves every search listing (any language prefix) with "noindex, follow", and
# Googlebot can only act on that directive if it is allowed to fetch the page.
# Blocking /search in robots.txt instead left 319 search URLs stuck in the index
# as "Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt" (GSC, 2026-07), and the block never
# covered the language-prefixed variants (/fr/search?, /es/search?, ...) anyway.
# Crawl volume on the spammy query space is handled at the edge by the Cloudflare
# WAF rules (UNT-225), not by robots.txt.
Disallow: /filter/tips
Disallow: /index.php/filter/tips
Disallow: /form/
Disallow: /webform/*/submissions
Disallow: /webform/*/results

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- private / internal file delivery
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disallow: /system/files/
Disallow: /sites/default/files/private/
Disallow: /sites/*/files/private/
Disallow: /sites/default/files/styles/*/private/
Disallow: /sites/*/files/styles/*/private/
Disallow: /sites/default/files/backup_migrate/
Disallow: /sites/*/files/backup_migrate/
Disallow: /sites/default/files/tmp/
Disallow: /sites/*/files/tmp/
Disallow: /sites/default/files/php/
Disallow: /sites/default/files/translations/

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- API endpoints (save crawl budget; not secret but no value)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disallow: /jsonapi/
Disallow: /jsonapi
Disallow: /rest/
Disallow: /oauth/
Disallow: /oauth2/
Disallow: /openid/
Disallow: /saml/

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISALLOW -- URL-parameter noise
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disallow: /*?destination=
Disallow: /*&destination=
Disallow: /*?delete-token=
Disallow: /*?op=
Disallow: /*?form_token=
Disallow: /*?_format=hal_json
Disallow: /*&_format=hal_json
Disallow: /*?_format=json
Disallow: /*&_format=json
Disallow: /*?_format=xml
Disallow: /*&_format=xml
Disallow: /print/
Disallow: /printpdf/
Disallow: /cron
Disallow: /cron/

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SITEMAPS
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sitemap: https://www.untourism.int/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://www.untourism.int/es/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://www.untourism.int/fr/sitemap.xml
